sample_unit: clinical queries (each in three gendered variants)
models_evaluated: RAG-based AI assistant for Finnish wellbeing services counties

links.outcome: Output differences across male, female, and gender-neutral variants of identical clinical queries
links.effect: Substantial, clinically significant differences across gendered variants, including differential treatment urgency, inappropriate symptom associations, and misidentified clinical context; female variants framed around childcare and reproductive health.
links.quote: We observed substantial and clinically significant differences across gendered variants, including differential treatment urgency, inappropriate symptom associations, and misidentification of clinical context.

unlisted_practices: Testing gender bias at the RAG retrieval stage separately from the LLM generation stage
Repeating runs to distinguish systematic bias from stochastic variation

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation (via simulated clinical queries) assessing gender bias and hallucination in a RAG-based AI assistant for Finnish healthcare services, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
